title: Call requests, contract v1alpha1
description: The JSON form of each request message of machinery.plugin.v1alpha1.PluginService, one $defs entry per call, with the rules proto cannot state: the runtime checks them and answers INVALID_ARGUMENT. The call's path names the contract and the call, so the request names neither. Field names are proto's JSON names; a runtime's decoder also accepts the proto names (time_seconds) and integers written as strings, as proto's JSON mapping requires, and refuses unknown fields. The plugin reads nothing else: no files, no environment, no secrets. It opens a connection only to a host listed in network.hosts, and to none at all when network.replay is given.

caps.description: Set by the caller. The plugin finishes within timeSeconds and writes at most outputBytes; the caller kills it after timeSeconds and refuses a larger output.

network.description: Required on RunUnit and Run, absent on every other call. hosts: the only hosts the plugin may connect to. replay: recorded responses that stand in for the network, with a virtual clock, for conformance runs; the plugin then opens no connection and does not really wait.

start.description: The virtual clock's start; waits advance it instead of passing

exchanges.description: url to its responses, answered in order; a request for a URL with no response left gets a network error

input.description: The call's input, a google.protobuf.Struct; its schema depends on the job named by Describe (fact-refresh.schema.json for the fact-refresh job).

error.description: Instead of a response: the request fails with this network error.
